description:

**Experience:** 4.5-7 years  
**Salary:** ₹35,000 – ₹50,000 per month  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** In person, as per project requirements

**About Us**  
Source Integreta is an aviation IT company delivering airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, and digital transformation solutions for airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects run in high-availability, round-the-clock environments where reliability and security matter most.

**About the Role**  
We’re hiring an IBM MQ Administrator to keep our enterprise messaging platforms stable, secure, and fast. You’ll install, run, monitor, and tune IBM MQ and related middleware, and work closely with application, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to support mission-critical airport systems.

**What You’ll Do**

*MQ & Middleware Administration*

* Install, configure, upgrade, and patch IBM MQ across dev, test, staging, and production
* Set up and manage Queue Managers, Queues, Channels, Listeners, Clusters, Topics, and access controls
* Run MQ on Linux, Windows, and cloud platforms

* Do regular health checks and preventive maintenance
* Track queue depth, channel status, and message flow performance
* Fix messaging failures, connectivity issues, and latency problems
* Manage SSL/TLS and certificates
* Implement backup, recovery, and DR procedures
* Maintain middleware standards, naming conventions, and runbooks

*Integration Support*

* Work with application teams, system integrators, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams during deployments
* Support integrations of airport operational systems
* Troubleshoot interfaces between enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and third-party applications
* Analyse message logs and transaction traces to find root causes
* Support SIT, UAT, go-live, and cutover activities

*Monitoring & Incident Management*

* Provide L2/L3 support for production incidents
* Join 24x7 support and on-call rotations when needed
* Carry out RCA and put corrective and preventive actions in place
* Meet SLA, availability, and KPI targets
* Keep incident records, logs, and documentation up to date

*Security & Compliance*

* Keep middleware compliant with cybersecurity policies
* Implement authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging
* Support vulnerability fixes, audits, and hardening with the security team

*Automation & Improvement*

* Write scripts to automate monitoring, deployment, backup, and maintenance
* Find ways to tune performance and improve operations
* Support modernization and cloud migration work

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or similar
* 2+ years of hands-on IBM MQ administration in production
* Experience on Linux and Windows servers
* Good grasp of TCP/IP, networking, firewalls, and secure protocols
* Experience with HA and DR configurations
* Shell or automation scripting knowledge
* Familiarity with ITIL incident and change management
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills

**Good to Have**

* Aviation, airport, transport, or other mission-critical experience
* IBM ACE/IIB, Kafka, ActiveMQ, or RabbitMQ
* Containerized or cloud middleware deployments
* Monitoring tools like Grafana, Prometheus, AppDynamics, or Splunk
* REST/SOAP APIs and integration patterns
* Large-scale integration project experience
* DevOps and CI/CD exposure

**Soft Skills**

* Ownership and accountability
* Calm under pressure in 24x7 environments
* Clear communication and coordination
* Attention to detail and discipline
* Proactive problem solving
* Good documentation habits
* Adaptability to new technologies

**Working Conditions**

* Shift support and on-call rotations may be required
* Support during production cutovers and migrations may be needed

**What We Offer**

* Work on large international aviation and airport technology projects
* Exposure to mission-critical enterprise integrations

Share your updated resume with project experience, certifications, and notice period details.

title: ServiceNow Administrator

OneSpan is building an internal ServiceNow capability to support Customer Support, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and IT. We are seeking a ServiceNow Administrator who is passionate about platform excellence, user experience, process improvement, and operational support.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with business users, configuring platform capabilities, supporting day-to-day operations, and helping drive adoption of ServiceNow across the organization.

* 20% Configuration & Continuous Improvement

* 20% Stakeholder Collaboration, Reporting & Documentation

* Ensure system configurations follow established governance and platform standards.

* Partner with developers when issues require scripting, integrations, or custom development.

*Configuration & Continuous Improvement (Approximately 20%)*

* Configure forms, fields, views, notifications, dashboards, reports, catalog items, knowledge bases, and platform settings.

* Build and maintain Flow Designer automations and no-code/low-code solutions where appropriate.

* Support enhancement requests and platform optimization initiatives.

* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve user experience.

* Participate in testing and validation of platform changes.

* Assist with documentation of configurations and support procedures.

**Reporting, Documentation & Stakeholder Support (Approximately 20%)**

* Create and maintain ServiceNow reports, dashboards, and KPIs.

* Support business users with questions, training, and platform adoption.

* Document system processes, support procedures, configuration decisions, and operating standards.

* Assist Business Analysts in validating requirements and testing solutions.

* Participate in backlog reviews, enhancement planning, and support prioritization discussions.

* Help communicate platform updates and process changes to users.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of ServiceNow administration experience.

* Hands-on experience administering ServiceNow in an enterprise environment.

* Experience with:

o User Administration

o Roles & Security

o Service Catalog

o Knowledge Management

o Reports & Dashboards

o Flow Designer

o Forms, Views, and Configuration Management

* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform navigation and administration.

* Experience supporting business users and troubleshooting platform issues.

* Excellent communication and documentation skills.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

* Experience supporting CSM, ITSM, SPM/PPM, or Service Catalog implementations.

* Experience working with Agile delivery teams.

* Familiarity with Jira and Salesforce.

* Exposure to integrations and APIs.

* Experience supporting platform upgrades and release management.

* Experience creating executive and operational reporting dashboards.

* AI and automation experience is considered an asset.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* You take ownership and follow through on issues until they are resolved.

* You are comfortable working directly with business users and stakeholders.

* You look for ways to simplify processes rather than add complexity.

* You balance operational support with continuous improvement.

* You are detail-oriented and maintain high standards for data quality and platform governance.

* You enjoy learning new platform capabilities and driving adoption across the organization.

* You can work effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.

**Why Join OneSpan?**

* Help build OneSpan's first internal ServiceNow team in India.

* Gain broad exposure across Customer Support, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and IT.

* Work directly with business stakeholders and platform leadership.

* Influence platform standards, governance, and future roadmap decisions.

title: Release, Delivery & Scrum Lead
description:
**ABOUT SIGHTVIEW**

Sightview Software LLC provides a suite of industry-leading software specifically geared toward ophthalmology and optometry practices — practice management, surgical, revenue cycle management (RCM), MIPS reporting, and more. Sightview is a one-stop shop for eye care specialists and their patients.

**Engagement** • **Integrity** • **Collaboration** • **Resilience** • **Accountability**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Release & Delivery Lead is the single accountable owner of how Sightview ships. This role owns the release calendar and Change Control Board process end-to-end, defines and enforces the checkpoints before, during, and after every deployment, and keeps internal teams and customer-facing stakeholders informed of what’s coming, when, and what it means for them. The Release & Delivery Lead also serves as Scrum Master for one or more delivery teams, bringing agile discipline to planning and execution, and partners closely with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Product, and Support to protect the reliability of every release our customers depend on for patient care.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Release Coordination**

* Own the release calendar for our products and coordinate scope, timing, and readiness with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Product, and Support.
* Run the Change Control Board (CCB) process, gather decision evidence, and coach the organization on the process elements.
* Facilitate release readiness (go/no-go) reviews and bring the right people together to assess tradeoffs and reach go/no-go decisions based on clear entry/exit criteria.
* Track release scope in Jira (fix versions, release tickets, dependencies) and keep status visible to stakeholders.
* Identify and track release risks, dependencies, and blockers early, and drive them to resolution or escalation in partnership with stakeholders.

**Deployment Process and Checkpoints**

* Document and maintain the pre-, intra-, and post-deployment processes, checklists, and runbooks in Confluence.
* Define clear checkpoints and owners for each phase: code freeze, regression sign-off, change approval, deployment window, smoke testing, rollback decision, and post-release validation.
* Coordinate live deployment events and act as the single point of coordination while a release is in flight.
* Lead post-release reviews and retrospectives, capture lessons learned, and turn them into process improvements.
* Keep release documentation audit-ready for regulated and compliance-driven reviews.

**Agile Delivery**

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more teams: facilitate planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coach teams and stakeholders on Scrum and Agile practices, and remove impediments to delivery.
* Help plan and align work across teams (PI Planning or equivalent) and manage cross-team dependencies.
* Track and report delivery metrics such as velocity, predictability, cycle time, release frequency, and escaped defects.

**Communication**

* Own internal release communications: release plans, deployment notices, status updates, and outage or maintenance notices.
* Partner with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Marketing on customer-facing communications, including release notes, maintenance windows, and feature announcements.
* Keep Support and customer-facing teams ready for each release with known issues, changes that affect workflows, and FAQs.
* Give leadership concise, reliable updates on release health and delivery status.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in software delivery, release management, or agile project delivery.
* 3+ years as a Scrum Master on software development teams.
* A proven record of coordinating production releases across several teams and functions.
* Experience writing and maintaining process documentation, runbooks, and checklists.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to write a clear deployment notice for engineers and a plain-language release summary for customers or executives.
* Hands-on experience with Jira (boards, fix versions, filters/JQL, dashboards) and Confluence.
* Daily fluency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.
* Comfort facilitating meetings with a wide range of people, from engineers to executives to customers.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle several release trains and deadlines.
* Enough technical grounding to follow deployment pipelines, environments, and release risks, and to ask engineers the right questions.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience as a Release Train Engineer (RTE) in SAFe, or leading releases across several Scrum teams (Scrum of Scrums).
* Certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), PSM, CSM, or ITIL 4 Foundation.
* A technical background, such as prior work as a developer, QA engineer, systems administrator, or DevOps engineer.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), environment management, and rollback strategies.
* Health IT experience, especially EHR/EMR, practice management, or other clinical software.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products and customer-facing maintenance windows.
* Experience in regulated environments, such as HIPAA, ONC Health IT Certification, or SOC 2.
* Experience with ITSM or change management practices (CAB, change records, release approvals).
* Experience working alongside a support organization (for example HubSpot or Zendesk) to connect releases with customer issues.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Regular use of a keyboard, mouse, and monitor, requiring repetitive hand and wrist motion
* Ability to communicate clearly by phone, video conference, and in person
* Ability to read and interpret information on a computer screen and in printed documents
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within a home or office environment
* Ability to occasionally lift and move office supplies or equipment weighing up to 15 pounds

title: Systems Engineering Advisor
description:
We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects — handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration — for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Advanced Application Packaging• Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
  

* Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.
* Apply Package Support Framework (PSF) fixups for MSIX compatibility including working directory, file redirection, and registry virtualisation fixes.
* Package and sequence App-V virtual applications including connection group configuration and dynamic composition.
* Design and implement Intune Win32 deployment strategies including staged rollouts, dependency chains, and supersedence workflows.
* Develop custom PowerShell pre-install, post-install, and detection scripts for complex packaging requirements.

Compatibility Remediation
  

* Analyse and resolve application compatibility issues including DPI awareness, UAC elevation, write virtualisation, and Windows 10/11 API compatibility.
* Apply and test compatibility shims using Microsoft Application Compatibility Toolkit (ACT) or PSF.
* Identify and remediate packaging issues causing deployment failures — custom actions, hardcoded paths, registry ACLs, and service configurations.
* Collaborate with application owners and vendors to obtain silent install parameters and resolve licensing or activation issues.
